entities.name: Newton's Second Law
entities.definition: Newton's second law of motion: the net external force on a system equals the time rate of change of its total linear momentum, ΣF = dp/dt; for constant mass this reduces to F = m a. Stated by Isaac Newton as Lex II in Philosophiae Naturalis Principia Mathematica (1687); standard modern formulation per Halliday, Resnick, Walker 12th ed., Ch 5.

provenance.source: Halliday, Resnick, Walker, Fundamentals of Physics 12th ed., Ch 5 (Newton second law, force and momentum); Principia (1687), Lex II.
